cause: ScrollController::jump_to clamps the requested value to [0, max_offset] before storing it (controller.rs:250).
evidence: Frame 3 (48 ms) after jumpTo(100000): Flutter offset 100000 then springs toward the extent; Incular 1400. Revalidated at a19bf487 by rerunning harness/run-frames.sh scroll__.
fix_direction: Keep the requested offset for out-of-range jumps and start the configured ballistic correction, as Flutter jumpTo does with forcePixels followed by goBallistic(0).
impact: A programmatic jump beyond the extent lands on the edge immediately in Incular; Flutter moves to the requested position and corrects with scroll physics, which changes intermediate offsets and motion under bouncing physics.
limitations: Only one out-of-range sample with default ListView physics on the Flutter side; bouncing and clamping correction paths not separately compared.
title: Out-of-range jump is clamped instead of springing back

cause: The page controller is the pixel scroll controller with no page-coordinate layer.
evidence: PageController is a type alias of ScrollController (scroll_views.rs:1036). rg for jump_to_page, animate_to_page, initial_page and a page getter found no page-coordinate API. The paired scroll__page_view__fraction_initial_page scenario reaches page 1 with deferred_jump_to(400) as a workaround.
fix_direction: Add page-coordinate configuration and jump/animate operations that convert using the viewport fraction and viewport extent.
impact: Callers must convert page numbers to pixel offsets themselves and cannot initialize, read or navigate a PageView by page index.
limitations: Source-only API finding; no behavioural scenario for the missing API itself.
title: PageController page-based navigation API is missing

cause: Controller construction stores defaults and restoration state only.
evidence: ScrollController::new (controller.rs:102) takes no arguments; the only constructor with restoration (controller.rs ~108) restores a saved offset. jump_to and deferred_jump_to are the only ways to set an initial position.
fix_direction: Add an initial-offset option applied on the first extent publication, with restoration taking Flutter-compatible precedence.
impact: The initial position cannot be configured at construction; callers must issue a separate command and handle viewport attachment timing.
limitations: Source-only. Flutter applies initialScrollOffset only when no saved offset exists; the precedence was not exercised.
title: ScrollController cannot configure an initial offset

cause: No public tree-aware operation resolves a descendant's geometry through enclosing scroll positions.
evidence: rg -n for ensure_visible, ensureVisible and ScrollPositionAlignmentPolicy in crates/incular-widgets and crates/incular-scroll finds nothing relevant; the only ensure_visible is raw_tooltip.rs:253 and is unrelated.
fix_direction: Add a tree-aware operation that walks ancestor viewports and applies Flutter-compatible alignment and animation policy.
impact: Applications cannot ask the framework to bring a focused or selected descendant into view, including across nested viewports.
limitations: Source-only. Revalidated at a19bf487 by search; the Flutter line range was not re-read in this run.
title: Scrollable.ensureVisible has no Incular equivalent

cause: ScrollController::jump_to (controller.rs:246-266) changes the offset and dispatches only an Update notification, skipping the start/end bracket that Flutter jumpTo wraps around forcePixels.
evidence: Independently rerun at a19bf487: frame 2 (32 ms) after jumpTo(125) from offset 0. Flutter has one start and one end notification; Incular has zero of each and one update in both. The same harness shows the animated path matches (scroll__controller__animate_activity_notifications), so the gap is specific to jumps.
fix_direction: Emit Start, Update and End around a changed jump in Flutter's order, consistent with the animated path.
impact: Listeners that start or stop state on scroll activity miss both events for programmatic jumps, while the same listeners see them for animations.
limitations: Notifications were observed at controller level in Incular and through NotificationListener in Flutter; the observation points differ. Drag and fling notifications are not covered.
title: Programmatic jumps omit start and end notifications

cause: No scroll intent or scroll action is defined for scroll views, and the runtime key router does not dispatch scroll increments.
evidence: Duplicate of focus_input-003, which already records that PageDown does not scroll a focused list (scenario focus_input__keyboard_page_scroll). Source: frame.rs:1953-1961 routes arrows only to menu focus. Flutter ScrollIntent bindings (app.dart:1283-1330) belong under focus_input-003.
fix_direction: Add ScrollIntent/ScrollAction equivalents with Flutter's line and page increments (page uses 80% of the viewport) and default bindings for arrows, page keys and home/end.
impact: A focused or hovered ListView, GridView or CustomScrollView cannot be scrolled from the keyboard without application code; this is a common desktop and web expectation.
limitations: Rejected as a duplicate; cross-reference focus_input-003.
title: Keyboard paging of scroll views (duplicate of focus_input-003)

cause: PageView does not expose a page-change notification path.
evidence: Scenario scroll__page_view__fling_page_changed: a controller notification listener (scroll_views.rs:1036 PageController alias, add_notification_listener on Update, rounding pixels/800) reports page_changes 1 and last_page 1, matching Flutter onPageChanged (1 and 1). Only the callback surface is missing.
fix_direction: Add an on_page_changed callback that fires once per rounded page change from depth-0 scroll updates, matching Flutter's _lastReportedPage guard.
impact: Applications cannot react to page changes in a PageView (for example, to update indicators or load content) without polling the controller offset.
limitations: Downgraded from P1 because a listener workaround exists. Callback timing is not identical in principle; the scenario counts the same final events.
title: PageView has no onPageChanged callback (controller listener workaround exists)
verified_by: orchestrator package rerun (scenario-backed) or independent source verification (source-only); see VERIFICATION.md and verification-source-findings.md

cause: Image loading has no scroll-activity awareness.
evidence: rg -n -i for scroll_aware and ScrollAware in crates finds no counterpart. Flutter's provider defers resolving images while the enclosing Scrollable is scrolling.
fix_direction: Provide an image provider wrapper that consults scroll activity and resolves when it becomes idle; belongs with the image package and needs its owner's review.
impact: Image decoding is not paused during fast scrolling in Incular, which may cost frames in image-heavy lists; visible only as performance or late image appearance.
limitations: Reassigned to the image package for the decode path; behaviour not measured.
title: No ScrollAwareImageProvider equivalent to defer image loads during scrolling
verified_by: orchestrator package rerun (scenario-backed) or independent source verification (source-only); see VERIFICATION.md and verification-source-findings.md

cause: Incular's selection tracker starts with no reported index, so the first layout reports index 0 as a change.
evidence: Frame 0, before any input: Flutter selected_changes 0, Incular 1 (selected_index 0 on both sides). Flutter seeds _lastReportedItemIndex from the initial item and reports only changes; Incular report_selection (wheel.rs:884-895) fires when last_selected_index is None.
fix_direction: Seed the last reported index from the initial item (as Flutter's _lastReportedItemIndex does) so only real changes report.
impact: Applications receive a spurious selection callback for the unchanged initial item, which can trigger work or state updates at mount.
limitations: Count-based; callback argument at frame 0 not recorded. Later count divergence is also affected by the lost first move (gestures-001).
title: ListWheel reports the initial selected item through onSelectedItemChanged
verified_by: orchestrator package rerun (scenario-backed) or independent source verification (source-only); see VERIFICATION.md and verification-source-findings.md

cause: Incular's wheel viewport does not centre children on the cross axis.
evidence: Frame 0 probe item0 (300 px wide child in an 800 px viewport): Flutter rect x 250 to 550 (centred), Incular x 0 to 300. Vertical position matches. The same geometry explains the scenario result: the drag at x=400 misses the Incular child, so the list does not scroll (offset 0 at the end versus Flutter 1950).
fix_direction: Centre each wheel child horizontally within the viewport (Flutter places it on the cross-axis centre) and keep hit-testing consistent with the painted position.
impact: Wheel pickers with narrower items are drawn at the left edge and only respond to touches on the left part of the list, unlike Flutter.
limitations: Frame 0 only for the horizontal position; no paint check. Causal link to the zero scroll is inferred from the hit point and not separately isolated.
title: ListWheel children narrower than the viewport are left-aligned instead of centred
verified_by: orchestrator package rerun (scenario-backed) or independent source verification (source-only); see VERIFICATION.md and verification-source-findings.md

cause: Incular's bouncing path emits Overscroll notifications from the boundary handling (activity.rs:328 region) where Flutter's bouncing physics produce none.
evidence: Final frame: Flutter overscroll notifications 0 with BouncingScrollPhysics (no parent, so applyBoundaryConditions returns 0 and setPixels does not call didOverscrollBy). Incular 32 overscroll notifications over the same drag. The clamping twin reports overscroll on both sides (Flutter 4, Incular 3; the difference is the lost first move, gestures-001).
fix_direction: Emit Overscroll only where Flutter's applyBoundaryConditions reports a clamped amount; bouncing returns 0 and should emit no overscroll notification.
impact: Listeners that treat overscroll as a boundary signal (for example, to show an indicator) fire for bounce in Incular only.
limitations: Source line not traced in full; the final counts are from one drag. Twin uses no parent physics on the Flutter side and ScrollPhysics::BOUNCING on the Incular side, which is the matched configuration.
title: Bouncing drag past the edge reports OverscrollNotification
verified_by: orchestrator package rerun (scenario-backed) or independent source verification (source-only); see VERIFICATION.md and verification-source-findings.md

cause: Not yet isolated; candidates are gesture arbitration between nested scrollables and the body placed inside SliverToBoxAdapter (sliver_descriptors.rs:630-640), which may not expose an inner scrollable to the gesture.
evidence: Frame 0 geometry matches (header 0 to 200, item0 at 200). Frame 3 Flutter header moved up 50 px (outer 50); Incular unchanged. Final: Flutter outer 200 and inner 1232, Incular outer 0 and inner 0. Plain ListView drags in the same harness scroll on Incular (scroll__drag__notification_order), so the nested gesture is not reaching either scroll position.
fix_direction: Confirm in an application and in a non-harness test; then route drags to the inner scroll position and coordinate with the outer position as Flutter's NestedScrollViewState does.
impact: A touch drag over a NestedScrollView body (app bars with inner lists) does not scroll anything in Incular.
limitations: Only one geometry and drag path; the gesture-001 first-move drop affects the first 50 px but not the total zero response. Severity P1 pending confirmation (it would be P0 as a wrong final state in common use).
title: NestedScrollView does not scroll under a touch drag in the harness
verified_by: orchestrator package rerun (scenario-backed) or independent source verification (source-only); see VERIFICATION.md and verification-source-findings.md

cause: Not yet isolated; candidates are hit-testing or gesture ownership for the sheet's inner list, or the sheet's drag path not reached from the inner controller.
evidence: Frame 0 geometry matches (sheet top 300, item0 at 300). Final: Flutter sheet size 1.0 after an upward drag of 200 px; Incular stays 0.5 and item0 stays at 300 (no inner scroll either). The same drag path scrolls a plain ListView in Incular.
fix_direction: Confirm in an application; then make the inner list hand upward drags to the sheet until max extent, as Flutter does.
impact: A draggable sheet built on a scrollable list does not respond to touch in Incular; sheets stay at their initial size.
limitations: Single drag path; the first-move drop (gestures-001) contributes only 50 px. Severity P1 pending confirmation.
title: DraggableScrollableSheet does not expand under a drag from its list
verified_by: orchestrator package rerun (scenario-backed) or independent source verification (source-only); see VERIFICATION.md and verification-source-findings.md
